ephesians.2.p1.b1.text: And you were dead in your trespasses and sins,

ephesians.2.p1.b2.text: in which you used to walk when you conformed to the ways of this world …

ephesians.2.p1.b3.text: All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh … Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.

ephesians.2.p2.b1.text: But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,

ephesians.2.p2.b2.text: made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses.

ephesians.2.p2.b3.text: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,

ephesians.2.p3.b1.text: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,

ephesians.2.p3.b2.text: not by works, so that no one can boast.

ephesians.2.p3.b3.text: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works,

ephesians.2.p4.b1.text: Therefore remember that formerly you who are Gentiles in the flesh …

ephesians.2.p4.b2.text: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, … without hope and without God in the world.

ephesians.2.p4.b3.text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.

ephesians.2.p5.b1.text: For He Himself is our peace, who has made the two one

ephesians.2.p5.b2.text: and has torn down the dividing wall of hostility

ephesians.2.p5.b3.text: … and reconciling both of them to God in one body through the cross,

ephesians.2.p6.b1.text: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.

ephesians.2.p6.b2.text: For through Him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.

ephesians.2.p7.b1.text: Therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household,

ephesians.2.p7.b2.text: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.

ephesians.2.p7.b3.text: In Him the whole building is fitted together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.

ephesians.2.p7.b4.text: And in Him you too are being built together into a dwelling place for God in His Spirit.
